name: Thai Basil Chicken with Jasmine Rice and Egg

components.name: Basil Chicken Stir-Fry
steps: Whisk oyster sauce, light and dark soy sauces, fish sauce, sugar and measured water.
Chop chillies, garlic, long beans, pepper and onion, keeping basil leaves separate.
Stir-fry garlic and chillies briefly in the 20 ml oil; add chicken and brown thoroughly, breaking up the mince.
Add onion, beans and red pepper; continue cooking until tender-crisp. Add prepared sauce, bubbling until lightly glazed.
Turn heat off and fold in basil so it wilts without losing aroma. Cook ground chicken fully to 74°C.

components.name: Jasmine Rice
steps: Rinse rice and cook with 295 ml water in a covered saucepan; rest after cooking.

components.name: Egg
steps: For earlier-week servings, fry eggs in the reserved 10 ml oil until whites and yolks are cooked to your household standard; for freezer portions omit egg and add it after reheating.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Source serves 2–3, fixed at 3. Source suggests rice and egg; measured ingredients here include both. Holy basil is freshest when added at the end.
Storing & reheating: Freeze basil chicken and rice separately; make fried egg fresh or use a fully cooked egg only for earlier-week meals.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
